text: dsh-plugin-browser 是供 DSH 使用的 Playwright 无头浏览器插件，接入 tools 注册六个模型可调用的浏览器工具。它可以打开网页并读取渲染后的标题、正文和链接，也能在页面间点击、填写输入框、保存视口截图及关闭会话。每个 agent 使用独立会话，没有 agent 时使用共享默认会话；插件卸载时会回收会话。适合需要浏览动态网页或自动完成页面交互的 DSH 用户。需提供可用的 Chromium，或配置系统浏览器路径；可调整超时、快照上限和截图目录。

dsh-plugin-browser gives DSH six Playwright tools to open pages, read rendered text and links, click, fill inputs, save screenshots, and close sessions. Agents get isolated sessions. Use Chromium or set a system browser path; timeouts, snapshot limits, and screenshot location are configurable.
想让 DSH 打开网页并读出 JavaScript 渲染后的内容。
有没有办法让模型查看页面标题、正文和链接？
让 DSH 能点击网页元素并继续观察页面变化。
我想让 agent 自动填写网页表单。
需要把当前网页保存成 PNG 截图，能用 DSH 做吗？
DSH 的普通网页抓取看不到动态页面，怎么操作浏览器？
I want my DSH agent to inspect JavaScript-rendered web pages.
Can the model click page elements, fill forms, and read the updated page?
dsh-plugin-browser 的功能「网页导航与渲染快照」：browser_navigate 接收绝对 URL，打开页面后返回标题、当前地址、渲染正文和链接；正文与链接数量可配置上限。
dsh-plugin-browser 的功能「页面点击与输入」：browser_click 按 Playwright CSS selector 等待可见元素并点击；browser_type 等待输入框可见后填入给定文本，操作超时可配置。
dsh-plugin-browser 的功能「保存页面截图」：browser_screenshot 将当前视口保存为 PNG，可传入文件路径；未传路径时写入配置的 screenshotDir 并使用带时间戳的文件名。
dsh-plugin-browser 的功能「独立浏览器会话」：工具调用按 agent 获取独立浏览器会话；无 agent 时共用默认会话。browser_close 可关闭当前会话，插件卸载时清理活动会话。
dsh-plugin-browser 使用 Playwright 启动 Chromium；若运行环境没有其 bundled 浏览器，需提供系统浏览器 executablePath。截图会写入配置目录或指定路径。

dsh-plugin-browser README · dsh-plugin-browser：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) community plugin that drives a **headless browser** with Playwright. It registers six model-callable tools that let the model read JavaScript-rendered pages, take screenshots, and automate page interactions — the capabilities the built-in `web_fetch` (plain HTTP) cannot provide.

dsh-plugin-browser README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `browser_navigate(url)` | Open a URL, wait for load, return rendered title, body text, and links |
| `browser_snapshot()` | Return the current page's rendered text (use between automation steps) |
| `browser_click(selector)` | Click an element (any Playwright CSS selector) |
| `browser_type(selector, text)` | Fill a text input |
| `browser_screenshot(path?)` | Save a viewport PNG; defaults to `browser-<timestamp>.png` in `screenshotDir` |
| `browser_close()` | Close the current browser session and release resources |

dsh-plugin-browser README · Tools：Each agent gets its own isolated browser session; calls without an agent share a default session. Sessions start lazily on first use and close when the plugin unloads.

dsh-plugin-browser README · Install：The plugin uses Playwright's bundled chromium by default. First-time setup installs the browser binary:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add github:you/dsh-plugin-browser
npx playwright install chromium   # from the profile directory
```

Then boot and ask the model, for example: *"Open https://example.com and tell me what's on the page."* The model calls `browser_navigate` and receives the rendered text.

dsh-plugin-browser README · Configure：Override the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: browser
  name: dsh-plugin-browser
  config:
    timeoutMs: 30000      # navigation/click/type timeout

`executablePath` points at a system browser instead of Playwright's bundled chromium — useful when you do not want the browser download.

dsh-plugin-browser README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build     # emits lib/index.js and lib/index.d.ts
pnpm run test

The test suite boots a local HTTP server and drives the **system Chrome** (skipped when Chrome is absent), so it needs no browser download and no real network. With Playwright's bundled chromium instead, install it once: `npx playwright install chromium`.
